title: PDF header shows the title, organization, date range in Mon D, YYYY form and the Product Type line; location is not shown
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You have downloaded the PDF with a known date range, Product Type, and a specific location selected.
steps: 1. Read the header's text block top to bottom.
2. Look for any mention of the selected location.
expected: 1. The header is two columns: a text block on the left (70% width) and the organization logo on the right (30% width).

2. The text block shows, in order: the report title "Sales By Customer Report"; the organization name; the date range; and the filter summary line "Product Type: {value}" where value is "Parts & Service," "Parts only," or "Service only."
3. The header date range shows start and end in the format "Mon D, YYYY," joined by an em dash — for example, "May 1, 2026 — May 31, 2026" — and always shows both dates (every range is bounded).
4. The location filter is NOT shown in the header; it scopes the data only.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
spec_ref: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 15 S15-R7; S15-R8; S15-R9; S15-R10; S15-R11
notes: KNOWN-LIMITATION ENCODING: the header uses "Mon D, YYYY" while body Date cells use "Mon DD YYYY" — the difference is intentional per the S15-R9 context note; do not file it as an inconsistency.
